title: Event teaser countdown
summary: A hype teaser for an event: the name slams in over loud graphic shapes, a diagonal band wipe cuts to a 3-2-1 or days-to-go countdown with bursts and colour swaps, and a second wipe reveals a poster lockup with the date, place and a call to action.
techniques: odometer digit roll with feathered window
motif clipped outside the copy box
gallery_share: Countdown and save-the-date teasers for launches, concerts and conferences are a staple of model-made social video.
limits: The countdown is a fixed three-hit structure (3-2-1 or one days-to-go roll); it is not a live clock and cannot count hours or minutes.
The day count is whatever the brief states; nothing checks it against the calendar on the day the video is posted.
Inter Display / Inter only; very long names set at a smaller size.
